dataList.dlg: Desire. And to the meaassuuuurrrreeee... Hm... A shame the tape's stretched so thin. That's too bad, it was one of my favorites. Well, not that I'll ever need to broadcast this derelict Voice again.

Doesn't this tape look especially shiny and plump? That's because it hasn't had much work to do—the Voice that announces the opening time and keeps the customers up to date on the latest fashions is always so punctual, you see. At this rate, I'm almost worried it'll forget how to let its voice out.

First, we let the tapes bask under the sunshine for just the right amount of time—not too long, not too brief—then tuck them away safely in the shade. A little sunlight exposure really spruces up the recorded Voice's vividness. Ah, in case you're curious what happens when a tape gets overexposed... It starts speaking the Voice it wants to, instead of the Voice it's supposed to. I've always got to keep a close eye on them during this process!

Shh. Would you mind? ... Huh, that message is the same as the one He always bestows on us at the end of each season. Not so much as a syllable out of place—the cadence, the inflections, the pauses and brief inhales between each word are completely identical. He sure does work in mysterious ways, but I wonder just how much of this is by His design.

I like to have a little chat with the sunshine whenever I begin to wonder if anyone's listening to my broadcasts at all. No one else in this department store listens to me quite as closely as she does, you see.

"Though thou canst sate thyself, thou shalt not. Though thou canst indulge, thou shalt..." Do you know what comes next? ... If you've been paying attention to the broadcasts, you should be able to guess it... You've been listening, right?

Back when the previous Crimson God's Voice still echoed through the halls, I'd play nursery rhymes for the children in the Lost Child Center, or classical pieces that suit the Luxury Hall's highbrow atmosphere.
Why don't I play them anymore? Well, because no one wants to hear that kind of music anymore. All the lovely tunes are dead and piled up over there now.

It seems that nobody cares about the worn-out Voice anymore. I'm going to need the newborn false god's Voice, as expected.
Hmm... There's that one who isn't bound by affiliation or trends... Perhaps he could get me a recording of the false god's Voice.
There are two ways to put the crimson ones under a spell. One's to let them hear the Voice, stopping just short of the full sentence. The other is... fuhu...
Ah, I'm still fiddling with the modulation—would you mind waiting a bit?
That false Voice has led you astray—I'm afraid I'll have to tuck you under a blanket and give those profaned ears a good cleansing wash.
Follow a wandering voice for long enough, and you're bound to lose your way.
慾求吧。如此一來……終將成汝。
Shh. Keep your voice down, please. You'll alarm the red ones otherwise.
Are you ready to lend your ears?
要仔細傾聽才行哦？
... The tinny ringing...
A little quiet, please.
The narration... ends here...
Fuhu, it's easy-peasy as long as you cared to listen~
Oh dear... some background noise crept in.

Shame, it's not as good as it could've been—the tape's all worn out. But it should be good enough for the Brand Manager. I should take this opportunity to grease up my blanket and make some new recordings.
Thus spake the Obsidian God: The profane shall fall, the Golden Resin untouched; Sisyphe shall be eternally preserved.
A blanketed imitation of a Voice could never have replaced the real thing...
